notes.title: Cooperative Mode
notes.content:
[h3]Hey, real men ♂ [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37745685/f24ffd79bf04bf3781412e66979e924f63a3722b.gif[/img]

[h3]New [b]Update[/b]:[/h3]

[h3][b]Cooperative Mode[/b] - eight great locations is available for you and your slaves walkthrough! [/h3]

[h3]Hurry up and try it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37745685/9b76df190141b8a1ef8e9bbda868e3f17ac018c9.gif[/img]

There's [b]voice chat[/b] available for you on the [b]V[/b] and [b]B[/b] buttons. 

To invite friends, create a[b] Private Game[/b] and then just invite your friends to the lobby via Steam Overlay. Your friends should be in the [b]Cooperative Mode Menu[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37745685/989fc999639f59df115562767a93c664433b1ccb.gif[/img]

[h3]Enjoy![/h3]
[i]Dungeon Master
[/i]

notes.title: «The Best Game You Suck At» - The Steam Awards
notes.content:
[h3]Hey real men ♂

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37745685/6cb74d92fb1d51dd011db596961a42754b14b004.gif[/img]

[b]The Steam Awards[/b] event has started, so [b]Dungeon Master[/b] asked you to vote for this game in the nomination "[b]The Best Game You Suck At[/b]" gachiBASS

We must pull up our pants, dust ourselves off and begin again to vote for this nomination.

Link to the vote: [url=]https://store.steampowered.com/steamawards/nominations?snr=1_4_660__promo-steamawards[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37745685/729346762e44a7780289b08e7455111a50a5c24e.gif[/img]

We are sure you will agree with this nomination if you have played the game to the end and watched [b]all the cutscenes[/b]. Thank you very much for your support! 

[b]Cooperative Mode with a New Campaign will be released in December![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37745685/5eb7674f1649e9c83a265bf59f3bde630a17062d.gif[/img]


[b]Advice from Dungeon Master:[/b]

► Drink 3 buckets of ♂ [b]Hot Milk[/b] ♂ in the morning every day to avoid dehydration and gain a boost of male power

notes.title: Release of Trading Cards, Emoticons & BGs!
notes.content:
[h3]Friends![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37745685/1b7522ff6a9b91f429a1f62ad286c347f1fe41e2.gif[/img]

In total, 5 badges (+1 metal), 10 cards, 6 emoticons and 3 backgrounds were added.[/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37745685/2a60fbbab4538126ea5f90a5aed9c06e72ea970c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37745685/d4072946b64273cbb296ebffa8519837632f2d73.gif[/img]

[h3]Thank you for your help and support on the way to obtaining these trading cards![/h3]

notes.title: Multiplayer & New Locations & Voice Acting
notes.content:
[h3]Hey, friends!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37745685/1b7522ff6a9b91f429a1f62ad286c347f1fe41e2.gif[/img]


Today a [b]major update for the game came out[/b], it was added:

[olist]
[*] [b]PvP Multiplayer [/b]- it's an alpha version, it can hold up to 100 players (from the all servers), there will be more updates in the future. We are waiting for your comments about it.

[*] [b]Three new locations[/b] - [b]Slave Hospital[/b], [b]Ricardo Milos Mansion[/b] and [b]Low-Poly House[/b], you can find it by clicking on "[b]Additional Content[/b]" button.

[*] [b]Professional voice acting[/b] for the main plot of the game has been added.
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37745685/d4072946b64273cbb296ebffa8519837632f2d73.gif[/img]


[b]Steam also approved trading cards for the game, so we will release them very soon. Thanks for your support and stay with us![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37745685/5eb7674f1649e9c83a265bf59f3bde630a17062d.gif[/img]

[i]Dungeon Master
[/i]
